book.name: 2 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha ya kabhiri ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Tumenyiri kubha, emibhiri gyeetu ni kye eriibhuru rye eriibhaga iguhi mukyaaro muno. Nawe tumenyiri kubha, hano gikusarika, Taatabhugya aratuha enyuumba yino etakwoombokwa kwa amabhoko ga abhaatu, nawe ni nyuumba yino eri mwiisaaro rya kirakeego.
Mumibhiri gyeetu gya bhoono turanyahaarika, kweego turiigoomba bhukongʼu kuhaanwa eziinyuumba zyeetu eziihya, no okwiibhohibhwa emibhiri gyeetu emihya gya mwiisaaro.
Hano tukwiibhohibhwa emibhiri emihya, tutakubha kingʼaabhi.

Eriibhaga tukyaari mubhihuuna bhyeetu, turanyahaarika bhukongʼu muziikoro zyeetu, kwo okubha amangʼana maaru garatutama. Etari kubha tureenda okuruusya emibhiri gino gikukwa, nawe tureenda okwiibhohibhwa emibhiri gino gitakukwa, okubha emibhiri gino gikukwa gimirwe na gino gitakukwa.
Taatabhugya niwe atubhanwiiri kwiiguru wa amangʼana gayo, na atuheeri Ekoro Muhoreeru, okubha abhe omwiimeerereri wa gayo.
Kweego, tune eriisigo eriibhaga ryoosi, yiingabha tumenyiri kubha, hano tukwiikara mumibhiri gino, turi kure no Omukuru.
Turiikara kwe enzira yo obhwiikirirya, etari kwe enzira yo okurora kwa ameeso.
Eheene tune eriisigo, na turarora hakiriku tuungatigiri emibhiri gino, no okugya kwiikara no Omukuru.
Kweego, eraabhe turiikara mumibhiri gino, kasi eraabhe turiikara kwo Omukuru, eriiseego ryeetu ni kumuzomeerya ewe.

Niigo, tukweenderwa etwe twoosi turiimeerera embere we ekituumbi kyo omuriinga kya Krisito, okubha wuyo woosi atinirwe ekiina na ahaabhwe amariho kuriingʼaana na gano yakoriri mukyaaro kino kwo omubhiri gwaaye, gabhe mazomu kasi mabhiihu.
Okugwaatania abhaatu

Ambe, tumenyiri kubha tureenderwa okumusuuka no okumwiigwa Omukuru. Kweego, turakora omukya okubharuta abhaandi, okubha bhabhone okumwiikirirya. Taatabhugya atumenyiri bhuzomu kyeego turi, na neenye nine eriisigo kubha emwe mutumenyiri bhuzomu mumutima gyeenyu.

Etari kubha turiikoombakoomba kweemwe, nawe tureenda okubhaha omweeya gwo okwiikumya kwiiguru weetu. Kwe enzira yiyo, murabha na amangʼana go okubhakyoora bhano bhakwiikumiirya gano bhakoriri embere ya abhaatu, etari kyeego bhari muziikoro zyaabhu.
Eraabhe turarorekana kya abhayaanga, ni kwiiguru wa Taatabhugya, nawe eraabhe turarorekana tuno obhwoongo, ni kwiiguru weenyu.
Obhuseegi bhwa Krisito bhuratukaangata etwe, kwo obhugazuro bhuyo, tumenyiri kubha omuutu wumwe akakwa kwiiguru wa abhaatu bhoosi, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubhuga abhaatu bhoosi bhakakwa.
Neewe akakwa kwiiguru wa abhaatu bhoosi, okubha bhano bhakwiikara, bhatige kwiikara kwiiguru waabhu abheene, nawe bhiikare kwiiguru wa wuno akakwa no okuryooka kwiiguru waabhu.
Kweego, kweemera bhoono tutakumureengya kweeki omuutu wowoosi kwo okumurora ego. Yiingabha eriibhaga eriirebhe twaari turamureengya Krisito kwe enzira yiyo, nawe bhoono tutakukora ego kweeki.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno agwaateeni na Krisito, abheeri omuutu omuhya, amangʼana ge ekare gahitiri, amahya gahikiri!
Gayo goosi ni mirimo gya Taatabhugya. Ewe atugwaateenie neewe kwe enzira ya Krisito.
Na neetwe atuheeri emirimo gyo okweerekya abhaatu enzira yo okwiigwaanibhwa na Taatabhugya.

Niigo okubhuga kubha, kuhitira ku Krisito, Taatabhugya yaari arabhiigwaania abhaatu neewe, okutama okubhabharira ebhibhi bhyaabhu. Na atuheeri etwe omurimo gwo okubhabhuurira abhaatu amangʼana go obhwiigwaani bhuyo.
Ambe, Krisito atutumiri kukora emirimo gyaaye, kwo okuhitira kweetu Taatabhugya arabhasabha mwiigwaane neewe. Kiyo nikyo kikugirya turabhasabha kwiiguru wa Krisito kubha, mwiigwaane neewe.
Krisito ataari ne ebhibhi bhyobhyoosi, nawe Taatabhugya akamubharira ebhibhi bhyeetu bhyoosi, okubha etwe tubharwe bhe eheene embere wa Taatabhugya kuhitira kweewe.
